segments.text:
V. 19.
Diſciple all nations—Make them my Diſciples. This includes the whole Deſign of Chriſt's Commiſſion. Baptizing and Teaching are the two great Branches of that General Deſign. And theſe were to be determined by the Circumſtances of Things: which made it neceſſary in baptizing Adult Jews or Heathens, to teach them before they were baptized; in diſcipling their Children, to baptize them before they were taught; as the Jewiſh Children in all Ages, were firſt circumciſed, and after taught to do all GOD had commanded them.
